title: release: the Docker image job fails at "Build and push" since Release #11838 (npm 18.0.0-next.2 published fine): `npm install -g @objectstack/cli` crashes in npm's peer resolution ("Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')")
body:
Filing gate: **① a red release step, measured.** The maintainer asked for this card (2026-10-16): 「11838 npm发成功了，docker失败了，立卡排查」 (Release #11838: the npm publish succeeded and the Docker image failed; file a card to investigate). Filed by the cloud seat `repo:cloud#1` (seat post #6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim; grade and lane are triage's.

## What failed
- **The run:** Release #11838, run `38841989023` (push to `main` at `e5136ff10f`, "chore: version packages (next) (#23481)").
  - `Publish 18.0.0-next.2 to npm` succeeded. npm's `next` tag is now `18.0.0-next.2`.
  - The **Docker image** job (`116791684282`) failed at **Build and push**.
- **Its annotation:**
  ```
  buildx failed with: failed to build: failed to solve: process "/bin/sh -c npm install -g @objectstack/cli@${OS_CLI_VERSION} \"pg@^8.0.0\" \"mysql2@^3.0.0\" && npm cache clean --force" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1
  ```
  The step is `docker/Dockerfile` line 69 (`FROM node:22-slim`).
- **The same step fails in the next three Release runs:** #11840 (`38845350311`), #11841 (`38845398889`) and #11842 (`38846177213`), Docker job red at Build and push in each. #11839's Docker job was skipped. The step's full log could not be read from this session (the log host is blocked by the egress proxy).

## Reproduced outside CI (Node v22.22.0, npm 10.9.4, the Dockerfile's command into a scratch prefix)
| Command | Result |
|:--|:--|
| `npm install -g @objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.2 "pg@^8.0.0" "mysql2@^3.0.0"` | **exit 1**: `npm error Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')` |
| the same with `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.1` | exit 1, same error |
| the same with `@objectstack/cli@17.7.0` (npm `latest`) | exit 1, same error |
| the next.2 command plus `--legacy-peer-deps` | **exit 0**: 526 packages, `os` / `objectstack` bins present |

**The crash site** (npm debug log):
```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')
    at #loadPeerSet (@npmcli/arborist/lib/arborist/build-ideal-tree.js:1289:38)
    at async #loadPeerSet (build-ideal-tree.js:1297:11)
    at async #buildDepStep (build-ideal-tree.js:904:11)
```
- **Just before the crash,** npm was fetching the peer set of `vitest` (`@vitest/coverage-*`, `@vitest/browser`, `@vitest/ui`, `happy-dom`, `jsdom`, `canvas`, `puppeteer-core`).
- **The only `vitest` edge among the CLI's 50 `@objectstack/*` dependencies** is `@objectstack/metadata-core`'s **optional** peer `vitest: ^4.0.0` (`peerDependenciesMeta.vitest.optional: true`). It is present in 17.7.0, next.1 and next.2.
- **What the reproduction implies:**
  - Every version fails today, including ones whose images built before.
  - So the trigger is probably a newer third-party release inside that peer graph meeting npm 10.9's arborist, not anything in next.2 itself. NOT MEASURED: which package and which version.
  - All published images are affected only for rebuilds. Already-pushed tags are not.
- **Every `@objectstack/*` dependency of the CLI at next.2 exists on npm** (checked one by one), so this is not a missing publish.

## Wanted (the lane picks; candidates, not a ruling)
- A Docker build that installs the CLI deterministically, for example:
  - `--legacy-peer-deps` (measured to work; check that no required peer is lost: `pg` and `mysql2` are installed explicitly);
  - or an install from a lockfile;
  - or a pinned npm version in the image.
- Or remove the cause in the dependency graph: no `vitest` peer on a runtime package (`metadata-core`).
- A follow-up Release run whose Docker job is green, and `ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/objectstack:18.0.0-next.2` pushed. The Release job may need a re-run, or a `docker-publish` dispatch for that version.
- Whatever is chosen, a check that a `node:22-slim` global install of the published CLI succeeds, so this fails before a publish and not after.

Related: Release runs #11838, #11840–#11842 · `docker/Dockerfile` · `.github/workflows/release.yml` / `docker-publish.yml`.
